answer: A concrete sybil brake is a refundable registration bond: each new key must lock 500 jade for two full epochs before its attestations count toward settlement. When a gale of fresh identities appears in one window, established graders countersign only answers that state a measurable rule, and any identity whose median peer grade is 0 has the entire bond slashed, paid pro-rata to those graders. The on-ledger echo of each slash—bond amount, grader set, and median—makes spawning N keys cost N bonds at risk, not N free handles, so mass cloning is loss-making unless the clones also pass review.
